description:
Due to his parents' treason, young Seon-Yu loses everything and becomes a slave. He is taken to the home of his former best friend, Tae-Kang, and forced into a life of scorn and beatings. Tae-Kang, who had been his best friend since childhood, became twisted after Seon-Yu neglected him during a difficult time, and he takes pleasure in teasing and observing his reactions. Meanwhile, Seon-Yu feels a resentment towards Tae-Kang, who, unlike him, enjoys the pleasure of being ignorant and nags him. Eventually, when Tae-Kang takes away the only solace in his difficult life, he vents his emotions through violence.

 *"If you've decided to take me in, you must take responsibility."* 

Can the precarious love story between these two men end safely?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

*Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi, Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.*
